run_history.first_attempt: Crashed before any return, eligibility count or result file was produced.
run_history.cause: Undefined session calendar included sparse and weekend rows; the held-price lookup did not skip NaN.
run_history.amendment_1: Defines the session calendar and prior-close carry that skips missing values.
run_history.amendment_2: Defines the first rebalance and abort gates without a grace period.
run_history.amendment_3: Defines earlier held-name ADV and missing execution-input handling.
run_history.fix: Filter all frames first; opt into earlier valid held inputs; count uses; enforce start and gates.

params.selection: top n_eligible // 5 by signal (ties: symbol ascending); benchmark all eligible
params.sizing: equal weight of current equity, fractional shares (simulate_rebalanced)
params.schedule: last session of each month; next-session open
